title: Laptop with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- laptop base -->
  <polygon points='18,72 82,72 90,86 10,86' fill='#5aa9e6'/>
  <polygon points='18,72 82,72 82,76 18,76' fill='#8fd0f7'/>
  <polygon points='10,86 90,86 90,90 10,90' fill='#3d7fb8'/>
  <!-- trackpad -->
  <rect x='42' y='79' width='16' height='7' rx='2' fill='#a6dcff'/>
  <!-- screen body -->
  <rect x='22' y='26' width='56' height='44' rx='4' fill='#3d7fb8'/>
  <!-- screen inner -->
  <rect x='27' y='31' width='46' height='34' rx='2' fill='#1e3a5f'/>
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 52 Q50 62 62 52' stroke='#ffe66d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='3' fill='#ff8fa3'/>

</svg>
